text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Marvey and Teio! ☆ So,
presents?
What'd you get?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I got you something very marvelous. ☆
The
wrapping is marvelous, and the
inside is
marvelous too! ★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, I know what it is—can't fool Maya!
And you,
Teio? Don't keep me waiting!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nghh, I spent a few days thinking about
it, but I
haven't been able to decide.
What's something
that would be just as
marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! How about I give you a
special peek
at a marvelous fighting
game technique of mine?
The secret
"Teio Spin"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's so good, no one's been able to beat
it yet. I'll
show you as many times as you
want. So, how
about it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I appreciate it, but... are you
sure?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If you let me learn it, it's never gonna
work on me
again. ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous! ☆ If I teach everyone how to
dodge it,
the whole school will be
marvelous! ★

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aww man, I really messed up!
